name: kingshot-pwa

scripts.wasm:debug: rm -rf web/pkg && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/kingshot_pwa.wasm
scripts.wasm:release: rm -rf web/pkg && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/kingshot_pwa.wasm

description: Kingshot mobile defense prototype running in the browser.
